label: Cape Town: April 2021 Table Mountain fire

verdict.headline: Real change
verdict.statement: Burn ratio (NBR) fell by 0.46 relative to the control trajectory in the 6 months after 18 Apr 2021 (90% interval −0.59 to −0.31). Of 30 untouched cells given the same test, 0 showed a divergence this large (placebo p = 0.03).

evidence.sentence: Optical and radar agree: burn ratio (NBR) fell by 0.46 and radar backscatter (VH) fell by 1.2 dB (combined placebo p = 0.06).
